question: Will Bradley Barcola join Liverpool?
rules:
This market will resolve to the next team Bradley Barcola officially joins by September 1, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

If Bradley Barcola does not officially join a new team by September 1, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Paris Saint-Germain".

If Bradley Barcola joins a team that is not listed, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Bradley Barcola is released, retires, or is not under contract with any professional team by September 1, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

An official transfer announcement prior to the market's close date will immediately resolve this market to the corresponding option.

The primary resolution sources for this market will be official announcements from Paris Saint-Germain and/or the acquiring team. A consensus of credible media reporting may also be used to resolve the market.

evidence.excerpt: Neither Bradley Barcola nor Ibrahim Mbaye travelled for PSG’s French Super Cup match against Lens, with Liverpool in talks to sign both. Liverpool were reported to be planning a new bid for Barcola, although PSG’s £145 million asking price remained an obstacle. Asked for an update, Luis Enrique said: “I will speak about the transfer window when it is finished.”

Barcola and Mbaye were omitted from PSG’s 20-man matchday squad against Lens. RMC Sport journalist Fabrice Hawkins reported that both players were on their way out and that discussions over moves to Liverpool would continue the following week.

Liverpool’s pursuit of Barcola remained ongoing, with PSG seeking a deal worth £145 million and Liverpool willing to pay around £102.6 million. Barcola was an unused substitute in PSG’s UEFA Super Cup win over Aston Villa. Luis Enrique said that when a player is unhappy at the club, a solution needs to be found.

According to Belgian journalist Sacha Tavolieri, Barcola had agreed personal terms with Liverpool for a five-year contract. Liverpool had not agreed a transfer fee with Paris Saint-Germain. PSG’s pursuit of Ajax winger Mika Godts was described as a possible factor in enabling Barcola’s departure.
Luis Enrique included Liverpool targets Bradley Barcola and Ibrahim Mbaye in PSG’s squad for the UEFA Super Cup against Aston Villa. The match was scheduled for Wednesday, August 12.
PSG’s signing of Maghnes Akliouche from Monaco could coincide with Barcola’s departure. Barcola, who scored three goals at the World Cup, was heavily linked with Liverpool.

Liverpool had held preliminary talks with PSG and Barcola’s representatives, but a significant valuation gap remained, with PSG valuing him at £145 million. Barcola had two years left on his contract and had indicated he would not sign a new one; a move to Liverpool was said to appeal to him. PSG would ideally keep Barcola, and their incoming wingers were not considered his replacements.
Arsenal had shown interest in Barcola, who had two years remaining on his PSG contract and showed no signs of wanting to renew. PSG’s £145 million valuation could present a problem for Arsenal.
